title: The passive voice: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.explanationEs: Pasiva en pasado con un plural: were + participio.

items.prompt: My car ___ at the moment, so I'm taking the bus.
items.explanationEs: Algo que se está haciendo ahora: pasiva continua, is being + participio.
Pasiva en pasado, con by para decir quién lo escribió.
Falta to be: This house was built in 1920.

answers: Is breakfast included in the price?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta en pasiva: is + sujeto + participio.

items.text: Thousands of emails ___ (to send) every second.
items.explanationEs: Algo que pasa siempre, con un plural: are + participio (sent).

answers: Two men were arrested by the police.
items.explanationEs: Two men pasa a sujeto: were arrested. By the police es obvio y se puede omitir.
The tickets es plural: have been sold.
